description: Template buyer personas. Company fit and persona fit are scored independently. The first persona whose headcountRange matches the account is used for drafting. Contact lookup tries that persona first, then the others in order: wrong persona, try the next role. The marketing and revenue leaders have no headcount range, so they are only ever a fallback role.

painPoints: Lead routing and scoring rules are brittle and hard to audit
Enrichment spend grows faster than pipeline
CRM data is stale, duplicated or missing key firmographics
No clear attribution from outbound touch to meeting booked
The founder is still running outbound manually
No repeatable system to find accounts showing buying intent
Unsure which messaging or segment actually converts
Marketing and sales run separate funnels at the same accounts
Paid spend rises while sourced pipeline stays flat
Hard to prove which ads and posts led to a meeting
Reps chase accounts that never showed any intent
Pipeline reviews can't say which channel sourced a deal
